extra.message: Use of File.createTempFile without proper file permissions can lead to insecure temporary files. The patch ensures that temporary files are created with restricted permissions (rw-------) on non-Windows systems to prevent unauthorized access. Replace direct calls to File.createTempFile with a helper method that sets appropriate file attributes.
